top_choice_rationale: P001 awards palladium-catalysed C-N cross-coupling to Buchwald and Hartwig alone. Ligand design and mechanistic work on oxidative addition, amine binding and C-N reductive elimination solved a problem distinct from the 2010 C-C couplings. Three decades of independent confirmation settle maturity, and two groups independently built the general catalysts, so the allocation is clean. The citation wording on general, ligand-controlled coupling keeps Kosugi's narrow tin-amide reaction a precursor, though the expert report should check this against the primary papers. P002 is second because it keeps the same clean part but adds a base-editing part crediting Liu alone, which leaves out Komor and Gaudelli and sits close to the 2020 CRISPR prize. P003 ranks above no award because condensates are a real concept, but physiological relevance is contested and the three-name cap omits Pappu and Mittag.
